name: Emlak Konut Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
summary: Emlak Konut Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S., a long-established brand in the construction sector, began. Establishing environmentally friendly, modern cities that would add comfort to human life was determined as a corporate vision. With this basic purpose, Emlak Konut became the architect of many innovative applications in its sector. Emlak Konut carried out projects that set an example and left a mark in the planned urbanization of our country. It built the most innovative cities of its time, large enough to give its name to the district it was located in.
